section.title: Likes
section.para: Users can like an issue, to say that they are affected by it or want it done, instead of adding a note that only says "+1". An issue shows how many users like it, the issue list has a sortable Likes column (add it to the columns of the list), and the summary page lists the most liked issues. Liking does not change the date an issue was last updated and does not send emails. The count and the likes are also available through the REST API, at /api/rest/issues/{id}/likes.

listitem.para: Whether to enable likes. It defaults to OFF.
The access level needed to like an issue. The default is REPORTER. The anonymous account can never like issues.
The access level needed to see who likes an issue. The default is DEVELOPER. Everybody who can see an issue sees how many users like it.
Whether users can like the issues they reported. It defaults to ON.
Whether users can like issues that are read only. It defaults to OFF. Taking a like back is always possible while likes are enabled.
